title: CLASSIFICATION PERFORMANCE METRIC ELICITATION AND ITS APPLICATIONS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical framework of metric elicitation for machine learning classifiers. While it extensively discusses fairness in classification (Chapters 5 and 6) to address social bias in contexts like hiring and sentencing, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or abstract moral/ethical reasoning frameworks. Its focus is on optimizing statistical metrics that reflect user preferences.
